nodes.evidence_snippet: atomic force microscopy (AFM) images show that the Pt thin-film electrodes ... characterized by islands of continuous Au nanoparticles, approximately 50 - 100 nm in particle size, with Pt or PtM nanoparticles densely wrapped around Au surfaces

nodes.characterization_summary: CV in 0.1 M KOH shows typical polycrystalline Pt features and a decrease in Hupd peak area upon transition metal decoration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cyclic voltammogram (CV) of the prepared Pt thin-film electrode in 0.1 M KOH (Figure 1b) shows the typical polycrystalline Pt surface features. ... clearly show the distinct decrease of the area of underpotential deposition hydrogen (Hupd) peaks

nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ ATR-SEIRAS spectra measured from -0.05 to 0.20 V in 0.1 M KOH ... Stark tuning rate of interfacial water molecules gradually increases on Rh- and Ru-decorated electrodes, while it decreases on Mo- and Au-decorated electrodes
